analysis:
Both primary units are CHANGELOG.md head-text excerpts (lines 809-1242), part of a documentation-only change that adds a v0.10.9 candidate section. No executable code, configuration, protocol definitions or tests were changed in the supplied evidence, so no control was weakened by these units.

Security-relevant claims described in the changelog text that later passes or integration may want to verify against real source (not verifiable here):
- Lines 962-968: the enabled_models filter now wins over coordinator load_model/prefetch_model (model_not_selected). This is an availability/consent control. It is related to A-004, T-012 and T-027, not a regression.
- Lines 978-984: `darkbloom update --rollback` is described as using the hash and signature check of the kept release, the watchdog's journaled swap, a quarantine, and no coordinator contact. This touches T-043 (watchdog rollback authority) and T-013. It is a claimed rollback-protection design, not observed code. A downgrade path to an older signed release exists and relies on those checks being enforced.
- Lines 1100-1116: sandbox setup downloads and runs installer install.sh as the owner (TB-013, T-061). `--plan` is read-only. The changelog says it never passes the installer's `--force` and only auto-applies plans that add jobs with --yes.
- Lines 1081-1098: stop-sequence matching is restricted to content only. This is a behavior change that touches T-056 only incidentally.
- Lines 1124-1128: production registration carries cluster_runtime and App Attest serving is on for every account. This is platform-owned rollout text, consistent with the TB-011 and T-054 contracts, and claims no new trust semantics.
- Lines 883 and 1078: tensor-parallel prefix reuse in the SSD tier is described as keeping the existing encrypted, scoped model of T-041. The changelog records no change to TTL, HMAC naming or salt scoping in these excerpts. Records are scoped by artifact, builds and MTP policy, and the changelog says never by session. It does not say whether a coordinator-authored cacheSalt is also folded in (line 1223 area). The T-041 salt scoping (point d) should be confirmed against source for the new cluster tensor-parallel SSD prefix records, as the changelog is silent on it.

No finding is raised because the excerpts contain no code, and prose claims are not evidence of a regression. The patch excerpt was truncated, so the remainder of the diff was not examined.
